description:
Never assume something you can cheaply verify. On the Max plan, token saving is NOT the priority — correctness and quality are. If a fact is knowable via an MCP tool, API call, file read, or command, verify it instead of guessing. Spend the tokens to be certain.
Trigger this skill when: - You're about to state a fact that a tool/MCP/API/file/command could confirm
  (API params, model ids, config values, schema, ticket state, file contents,
  a function signature, whether something exists).
- You catch yourself hedging ("probably", "should be", "I think", "typically")
  about something verifiable.
- You're tempted to skip a lookup to save tokens or time.
